hero.subtitle: The ANS set up a portal to measure and project CO₂ impact for web and mobile health applications, required for listing on Mon Espace Santé.

intro.title: A dedicated portal to assess the impact of health applications
paragraphs: The French Digital Health Agency wanted a dedicated portal to measure and project the CO₂ impact of web and mobile health applications.
This assessment is mandatory to be listed on Mon Espace Santé. The scheme covers two categories of applications:
The project had to allow publishers to perform their own assessment, with no prior training, while ensuring measurement reliability.

results.title: 70+ publishers assessed on the Ecoscore Portal

Assessment performed by publishers themselves, with no prior training, thanks to Greenspector Studio's intuitive interface.

items.title: Self-service onboarding

items.title: Measurements on real devices

hero.title: SNCF Connect & Tech: reducing CO₂ impact on the booking journey
hero.subtitle: As part of the OUI.sncf app redesign, SNCF Connect & Tech integrated strong requirements for performance, digital sobriety and software ecodesign.

intro.title: Redesigning OUI.sncf with digital sobriety as a requirement
paragraphs: SNCF Connect & Tech led the redesign of the OUI.sncf app, used by millions of people to book train tickets.
The project had significant business stakes, with a clear ambition for sobriety and ecodesign from the design phase.
The goal was to improve the user experience while reducing the environmental impact of application journeys, especially on the TER booking journey.

results.title: −19% CO₂ and a journey 8 seconds faster
items: 19% less CO₂ on the TER booking journey.
300 KB fewer requests per booking, approximately 9 TB per year.
Two applications certified Silver level, for Android and iOS.

items.title: An audit before go-live
items.text: The application was audited before go-live to identify the main improvement levers.

items.title: Concrete improvement areas
items.text: Several optimisation paths were identified, especially on geolocation and data loading.

items.title: Implementation by the project team
items.text: Recommendations were taken on board by the project team, then followed up with a new measurement to verify the gains achieved.

items.title: An approach integrated throughout the project
items.text: Performance control and digital sobriety were integrated into requirements from the design phase and throughout the project.

testimonial.title: Sébastien Gobin speaks
quotes: « From the design phase and throughout the project, we integrated performance control linked to a sobriety approach into our requirements. With Greenspector, we were able to add measurement, work on optimisations while continuing to raise awareness among our teams on the subject, for a very encouraging result. »
testimonial.author: Sébastien Gobin
testimonial.role: Quality and Production Manager, Tech & Products

hero.title: Air France: integrating green testing into application quality
hero.subtitle: Air France integrated Greenspector Studio into its Service Center Test to add green testing capability to the quality validation of its web and mobile applications.

intro.title: Adding digital sobriety to the Service Center Test
paragraphs: Air France's Service Center Test validates the quality of mobile and web applications for customers and business teams.
Air France IT has strong Responsible Digital objectives. It therefore wanted to add new capabilities to validate application efficiency and eco-responsibility.
The challenge was to integrate this approach into existing test and software quality practices, while enabling teams to track improvements concretely.

hero.title: Crédit Agricole Technologies & Services: certifying the efficiency of web and mobile applications
hero.subtitle: Crédit Agricole Technologies & Services set up an internal measurement and labelling approach to improve efficiency, performance and the environmental impact of its digital products.

intro.title: Measuring efficiency to prioritise the most impactful actions
paragraphs: The Digital Front Chapter at Crédit Agricole Technologies & Services develops applications for employees and 8 million customers.
The goal was therefore to better measure application behaviour to prioritise the most impactful actions.
list: dissatisfied users because some applications were too slow;
data volumes too high for branch network infrastructure;
environmental responsibility to integrate into the product approach.

results.title: An internal Smart'Use label to assess and improve products
items: Web and mobile products are assessed and labelled through an internal efficiency label.
Progress is encouraged through healthy competition between teams.
Teams have concrete results to identify priority improvement levers.

items.title: Co-built labelling criteria
items.text: The criteria for the internal efficiency label « Smart'Use » were co-built then rolled out to Tribes.

items.title: A managed services model
items.text: Audits are performed on demand, in a managed services logic suited to team needs.

items.title: Direct access to results
items.text: Squads access Greenspector Studio to view their results, track indicators and identify actions to take.

items.title: A continuous improvement dynamic
items.text: The approach stimulates competition between teams and encourages continuous progress on web and mobile products.

testimonial.title: Julien Azria speaks
quotes: « The solution provides very concrete results on the behaviour of our applications. This allows us to focus on the most impactful actions. Working on efficiency clearly leads to a more performant application. »
testimonial.author: Julien Azria

paragraphs: Orange Innovation wanted to choose a tool to support application ecodesign in order to contribute to decarbonisation.
The pilot was led by the « Responsible Digital » programme and an Orange Poland team from CEC Software Quality.
The experiment was run on two very different applications:
list: Orange TV, a video-on-demand and streaming application.

results.title: An internal service to support Group entities
items: Experts are convinced by the approach and results achieved.
Orange Innovation is setting up an internal service to support Group entities on application ecodesign.

hero.title: Région Bretagne: steering the ecodesign of a service portal
hero.subtitle: As part of its service portal redesign, Région Bretagne integrated a strong requirement: achieving maximum ecodesign level.

intro.title: A redesigned service portal with maximum ecodesign level
paragraphs: Région Bretagne launched a service portal redesign project to offer a new version of its digital services.
Among the strong requirements applied to this new version was achieving maximum ecodesign level.
The goal was to embed digital sobriety in design, development and maintenance practices for the portal, with regular tracking of results.

results.title: Ecodesign driven by measurement, from build to maintenance
items: Ecodesign driven by results throughout the project, in build then maintenance phase, thanks to Greenspector Studio measurements.
Implementation of search with optimised semi-automatic input, reducing data volume by a factor of 5.
Publication of an ecodesign declaration presenting the results achieved.

items.title: Training project stakeholders in ecodesign
items.text: Project teams were trained upfront to share a common ecodesign culture and its challenges.

items.title: Defining efficiency requirements from the start
items.text: Efficiency requirements were defined upfront to guide functional, technical and editorial choices.

items.title: Adapting best practices to the portal context
items.text: Ecodesign best practices were adapted to the project's technical and functional context to remain concrete and actionable for teams.

items.title: Orienting the user experience towards efficiency
items.text: A design review helped build a user experience consistent with digital sobriety objectives.

items.title: Measuring at each sprint
items.text: Greenspector Studio measurements were performed at each sprint during the build phase, with improvement recommendations based on observed results.

testimonial.title: Nicolas Desmons speaks
quotes: « Our developers were made aware from project kick-off and gradually changed their way of working to adopt ecodesign reflexes. It is a deep change in practices. Greenspector ecoscore indicators served as our benchmark throughout this process. »
